title: Data Entry Admin - Basingstoke
description:
Data Entry/Administration Support

Contract Type: Fixed-term contract - End of October
Location: Basingstoke
Hourly Rate: 15.20
Start Date: ASAP
Working Pattern: Full Time, 37 hours per week (Monday to Friday)

Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with a leading organization in the transportation sector? We are seeking enthusiastic and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Data Entry/Administration Support! This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to a vital project as we transition to a new rostering system.

Role Purpose:
As part of our team, you will play a key role in supporting the implementation of our new rostering system. Your efforts will assist our staff in running the new system parallel to the existing one, ensuring a smooth transition and effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Input data into the new rostering system accurately and efficiently.
- Provide administrative support to existing staff as needed.
- Report any issues to the Team Lead to ensure quick resolution.

Essential Skills and Experience:
- Proven experience in data input and administration duties.
- Strong skills in coordinating, information gathering, and reporting.
- Quick learner-training will be provided!

Desirable:
- Experience within the rail or passenger transport sector, particularly in staff rostering.

Knowledge and Capability:
- Experience in a fast-paced office environment.
- Excellent data input speeds-accuracy is critical!

Personal Attributes:
- Highly organized with a keen attention to detail.
- Calm and effective under pressure, especially during time-sensitive tasks.
- Strong communicator who engages confidently with the team.
- Adaptable and eager to learn new skills.

Join our dynamic team and be part of a project that makes a difference! If you are ready to bring your talents to a fast-paced environment and thrive in a role that requires precision and adaptability, we want to hear from you!

How to Apply:
Don't miss out on this exciting opportunity! Send your application and CV today to join our dedicated team. We can't wait to meet you!

Get ready to take your career to the next level with us!

Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. title: HR coordinator
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Overview:
Weare seeking an experienced and customer-focused HR Coordinator to providehigh-quality administrative and operational HR support across the employeelifecycle. As a key member of the HR team, you will be the first point ofcontact employees and managers, ensuring efficient HR service deliverywhile maintaining accuracy, compliance, and confidentiality.

Location:Basingstoke, UK (On-site)
Contract:12-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Hours:Full-Time, 37 hours per week
Start Date: September/October
Salary: A per hour rate, in-scope IR35 of £15 -£17 per hour

Key Responsibilities
- Act as the first point of contact for HR-related queries from employees and managers.
- Provide guidance on HR policies, procedures, and employee life cycle processes.
- Support employees throughout their employment journey and ensure a positive experience.
- Escalate complex employee relations and compliance matters when required.
- Manage HR administration across the employee life cycle, including:
- New hire administration and onboarding
- Employee transfers, promotions, and organisational changes
- Leave and absence of administration
- Offboarding and termination processes
- Prepare and maintain HR documentation, correspondence, and employee records.
- Coordinate onboarding activities to ensure a seamless employee experience.
- Partner with Payroll to ensure employee changes are processed accurately and on time.
- Assist with benefits administration and employee queries.
- Support annual compensation and benefits review processes.
- Participate in HR projects and organisational initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience
- 3-5 years of experience in HR Administration, HR Operations, Shared Services, or a similar HR support role.
- Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
- Excellent organizational and prioritisation abilities.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
- Experience handling confidential employee data.
- Fluent English communication skills.

Preferred
- Fluency in a second European language (German, French, Spanish, Italian, or Dutch).
- Experience supporting employees across multiple countries.
- Experience with HRIS platforms such as Darwin box, Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar.
- Knowledge of end-to-end employee life cycle processes.
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or equivalent HR administration experience.

Ifyou are interested or anyone who you may know, please send across a copy ofyour/their most recent CV and availability for a chat by tomorrow.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
Role: HR Coordinator

Location: Basingstoke

Contract Length: 12 Months

Salary: £28,860 to £32,708

Randstad has partnered with an independent Microbiology business.

The role

In this role, you'll be at the heart of the HR function, acting as its operational backbone. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality administrative and operational HR support across the employee lifecycle. Serving as the first point of contact for employees and managers, you will provide timely guidance, process HR transactions, and maintain accurate employee records. Furthermore, you will help establish efficient and scalable HR processes, ensuring a positive employee experience while maintaining compliance, accuracy, and confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities
- Serve as a point of contact for day-to-day HR queries from employees and managers, providing guidance on HR policies and procedures.
- Manage HR administration activities including new hire administration and onboarding, organisational changes, leave administration, and offboarding.
- Maintain accurate employee records within HR systems and databases, ensuring all data is updated in a timely manner.
- Partner with Payroll to ensure employee changes are processed accurately and on time, and support benefits administration.
- Ensure HR processes comply with company policies and applicable employment legislation, maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive information with discretion.

What you'll bring
- Experience working in an HR Administration, HR Operations, Shared Services, or similar administrative role.
- A strong customer service mindset with excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail, alongside strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
- Fluency in English.
- A CIPD Level 3 qualification or equivalent HR administration experience is desirable, as is fluency in a second European language.

Randstad Business Support is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator Temp to Perm

Location: Basingstoke, Hampshire
Salary: £13.25 per hour (in the region of £28,000 upon successful temp completion)
Job Type: Temporary to Permanent
Hours: Full-time, 0800 to 1700, Monday to Friday

Vanta Staffing are currently recruiting for a Sales Administrator to join a successful and growing business based in Basingstoke. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised, proactive and customer-focused individual to join the team on a temp-to-perm basis, with the opportunity to secure a permanent position following a successful temporary period.

Our client is an established, employee-owned business with a strong people-first culture. They pride themselves on providing an exceptional service to their customers and have built a supportive, collaborative and hands-on working environment.

The Role

As a Sales Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting the sales and branch operations, ensuring customers receive a professional and efficient service. Working closely with the General Manager and Sales Supervisor, you will be responsible for a variety of administrative and customer service duties.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond to customer enquiries via telephone, email and in person in a professional and timely manner.
- Process customer orders, quotations, enquiries and returns accurately and efficiently.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with customers and colleagues.
- Handle customer complaints and resolve issues effectively, escalating where appropriate.
- Provide administrative support to the General Manager and wider branch team.
- Assist with data entry, reporting and document management.
- Support the branch with statutory, regulatory, Health & Safety and compliance requirements.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure information is kept up to date.
- Assist with general sales and administrative duties as required by the General Manager and Sales Supervisor.
- Work collaboratively with the wider team to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the branch.

About You

We are looking for someone who is organised, commercially aware and customer-focused, with a proactive approach to their work.

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience within sales administration, office administration, customer service or a similar role.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- A proactive approach and the ability to use your own initiative.
- Strong IT skills, including good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a busy environment.
- A positive, flexible and team-focused attitude.
- A genuine commitment to providing excellent customer service.

What s on Offer?
- Temp-to-perm opportunity
- 25 days annual leave + Bank Holidays upon permanent employment
- Statutory pension
- Company performance-related bonus scheme
- Share Purchase Scheme
- On-site parking
- Supportive and inclusive working environment
- Opportunity to join a growing, employee-owned business
- Excellent long-term career prospects

Why Join?

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career within a successful and growing organisation. You will be joining a business where employees are genuinely valued and encouraged to contribute, develop and grow.

Vanta Staffing are proud to be recruiting for this opportunity and are looking for candidates who are keen to secure a permanent position following a successful temporary assignment.

If you are organised, customer-focused and looking for your next opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Apply today with Vanta Staffing!

Vanta Staffing are working as an employment agency in relation to this role

title: Service Coordinator
description:
Transport Service Coordinator
Salary: Competitive salary with an annual performance bonus (15%) plus Veolia benefits and pension
Hours: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week 8:30am - 5pm
Location: Basingstoke, RG24 8 FB
When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. It's why we're looking for someone who's just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life.
We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture.
What we can offer you;
- 25 days of annual leave
- Access to our company pension scheme
- Stream - Employee financial well being support: early access to your earned pay, savings, budgeting, financial coaching & rewards
- Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers
- Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to
- One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community
- Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full potential

What you'll be doing;
- Day-to-day management of service delivery, including the dynamic allocation of work to vehicles/routes
- Communicating with customers and stakeholders, providing status updates and maintaining contact with drivers
- Completing debriefs with front line staff and reporting necessary actions or updates as required Face-to-face engagement with drivers, supporting them to address any issues on route
- Reporting of all safety concerns or container damage and encouraging 'stop the job' if it is deemed unsafe to continue
- Ensuring Veolia legal compliance on-site (WTD, O'licence and transport compliance)

What we're looking for;
Essential
- Able to demonstrate an understanding of transport compliance and WTD
- Good communication skills communicating with people of all levels including drivers, frontline employees and customers
- Ability to organise a busy workload and operate at a fast pace Working with a quality management system e.g. ISO Managing transport compliance.
- Experienced IT Skills, and the ability to adapt to Google operating systems

Desirable
- Previous experience operating within a similar industry; waste/transport/logistics

What's next?

Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.

We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.

We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long-term condition who opt-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles.

We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
